title: Bitcoin App Bottle Pay Shuts Down Over Impending EU Money-Laundering Laws
snippet: Bottle Pay is shutting down, citing the EU's new AML rules, which could compel crypto wallet providers to collect KYC info from users starting next month.

title: Netherlands Plans to Punish Crypto Scammers With Up to 6 Years in Jail
snippet: The Dutch government is about to get tougher with fraudulent schemes involving banking apps and cryptocurrencies.

title: SEC Taking ‘Measured’ Approach to Digital Asset Regulation, Jay Clayton Tells Senate Committee
snippet: The chairman of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Jay Clayton, says his agency is taking a "measured" regulatory stance on "promising" blockchain tech.

title: China’s SEC May Soon Have a Crypto-Savvy Department Chief: Report
snippet: China's securities watchdog is reported to be hiring Yao Qian, the former head of the central bank's digital currency initiative, as the chief of its new tech regulation bureau.

title: FinCEN Sees Jump in Crypto-Related Suspicious Activity Reports
snippet: Crypto companies have filed 7,100 Suspicious Activity Reports since May, America’s anti-money-laundering chief said at a banking conference Tuesday.

title: Mnuchin ‘Fine’ With Libra Launch, But Crypto Project Must ‘Fully’ Comply With AML Rules
snippet: Steven Mnuchin, secretary of the U.S. Treasury, has no issue with the launch of the Facebook-led Libra project – as long as financial rules are followed to the letter.

title: Top US Financial Regulators Urge Monitoring of Digital Assets, Stablecoins
snippet: A panel of top U.S. financial regulators urged federal and state officials to monitor risks from digital assets like bitcoin.

title: The SEC Has a New Chief Crypto Cop
snippet: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has appointed a new head of the cyber unit that tackles crypto firms breaking the law.

title: Sri Lanka’s Central Bank Calls for Blockchain-Based KYC Proposals
snippet: Sri Lanka's Central Bank wants to use a blockchain system for local banks' "know-your-customer" protocols.
